description.value:
Frequency 1/round

A quick half-step and re-grip converts what would be your third, heavily-penalized attack of the turn into a fresh Strike against your current Mark only, with your multiple attack penalty on it reduced by 2 instead of the usual amount.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live). This card's real blocker is independent and confirmed this pass: the MultipleAttackPenalty rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/actor/helpers.ts:171-197, used by Flurry) sets ONE alternate {map1, map2} pair as a package -- it can't leave your second attack's -5 untouched while only improving the third attack's -10 to -8, because calculateMAPs picks a single winning MAPSynthetic for both numbers together (a tie on map1 means the base always wins, so an entry with map1 unchanged never overrides map2 alone). "Reduced by 2 instead of the usual amount" on the third attack only has no matching rule-element shape.
